title: 矽光子與 CPO 光引擎
titleEn: Silicon Photonics and CPO Optical Engines
summary: 48 項循序任務：由波導、光源與調變器進入光纖封裝、IL/PDL、熱串擾矩陣、應力相位、製程公差、N−1 備援與端到端 BER 驗收，含可手算的自訂工程案例。
summaryEn: Forty-eight sequential tasks connect waveguides, sources and modulators with fiber packaging, IL/PDL, thermal-crosstalk matrices, stress-induced phase, process tolerance, N−1 redundancy and end-to-end BER acceptance, with reproducible authored examples.
scope: 矽光子與 CPO 共同設計的原創教學；24 項基礎任務後新增 24 項定量設計審查。算例不是商用 PDK 或原廠實測，外部研究依其公開測試條件引用。
scopeEn: Authored silicon-photonics and CPO co-design teaching, preserving 24 foundational tasks and appending 24 quantitative reviews. Examples are not commercial PDK values or vendor measurements; cited research retains its published test conditions.
